creator: Creator
delete_this_service_account: Delete service account "{name}"? Its tokens are removed with it.
service_account_hint: A service account has no password and cannot sign in. Its tokens keep working when the creator is disabled or deleted. Only administrators can disable or delete it.
service_account_teams_hint: The role cannot be higher than your own role in that team.
service_account_tokens_hint: The secret is shown only once. A token carries every team role of the account; only administrators and owners of all its teams manage it. To rotate, create a new token and then revoke the old one.
